english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things derived from living organisms, carbon compounds, and food grown without artificial chemicals.

examples.english: These vegetables are organic and grown without chemical pesticides.
examples.traditional: 呢啲菜係有機種植，冇落化學農藥。
